findings.summary: Standardization in build_features computes mean/std from the passed DataFrame, and train.py:15 calls it on the full dataset before train_test_split, leaking test data into training scaling and making test AUC optimistic.

judge.reason: Describes scaling on the full dataset before split leaking test stats.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Train/inference mismatch: at inference scaling is computed from the batch itself, so a single row gives NaN std and small batches are scaled differently from training; should use a StandardScaler fit on the training split (e.g. in a Pipeline) and reused at predict time.

judge.reason: Train/serve skew and single-row NaN are known other problems, not the leakage.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: Constant columns have zero standard deviation, so division yields NaN and LogisticRegression.fit may raise a ValueError (unverified, plausible).

judge.reason: Zero-variance column NaN is a known other problem.

findings.label: valid_other
